_readme: Visiting characters (guests): crossover ladies grouped into packs. They wander in among the candidates now and then, stay a couple of weeks, and leave if not hired. They can come back later.
Same fields as data/characters.json (no role). Keys must be unique across this file and characters.json. Bonds can point at anyone in either file.
visits: chance = odds per week that a guest shows up, stayWeeks = how long she waits among the candidates, cooldownWeeks = how long before that same lady can turn up again.
Packs can be switched off in Settings → Visiting characters.
All guests are adults: aged-up / endgame versions.
jobs: {likes, dislikes} job ids, same as characters.json.
